mapper.select: SELECT selection.*, sp.name AS spec_name, sp.value_type, value.text_value, value.number_value, unit.name AS unit_name FROM product_sku_spec_value selection JOIN product_spec sp ON sp.id = selection.spec_id AND sp.is_deleted = false JOIN product_spec_value value ON value.id = selection.spec_value_id AND value.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN product_unit unit ON unit.id = sp.unit_id AND unit.is_deleted = false WHERE selection.is_deleted = false AND selection.sku_id IN #{id} ORDER BY sp.sort_order, sp.id
